article.title: Climate Refugees: The notion remains largely taboo
article.author: Editor
article.content: "Migration in response to environmental changes has been a constant throughout human history and represents a rational adaptation strategy,” UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres once said when he was still UN High Commissioner for Refugees. The post Climate Refugees: The notion remains largely taboo appeared first on MR Online .
